reason: Official Kaggle staff now supports 12B. Previous matched 31B V2 5min/28call trial resolves 1/3 on fixed repo-stratified tasks while optional Skill was never invoked.

hypotheses.H_capacity: 31B semantic patch quality dominates; 12B may fail more tasks despite more throughput
hypotheses.H_throughput: 12B faster inference improves patch revision/time budget enough to rescue at least one of three previously 31B-unsolved tasks
hypotheses.H_infra: 12B unified architecture requires vLLM hf-overrides and may fail loading; startup success is feasibility, not quality

control.model_note: Same exact official V2 controls with original sampling and native tools, no optional Skill. This is previously used public development evidence.

changes: runtime model checkpoint path and vllm --hf-overrides required by official 12B support

shared.benchmark: swegemma official public-development task grader on existing 3 issue IDs, no gold/reference patch exposed to model
shared.selection_rule: Recompute EXACT identical salted-hash minimum unexcluded ID from each fastapi_,rich_,requests_ group from frozen original manifest; never use 31B outcomes to pick new IDs.

primary: Paired per-ID grader resolved 12B-vs-existing 31B control, including rescues and regressions
secondary: model actually started and native tool calls
promotion_rule: 12B >=2/3 with no infrastructure errors is preliminary only; require NEW disjoint paired cohort before any official competition submission. Otherwise reject size-only hypothesis as this task evidence.
stop: No 12B model availability, wheelhouse/compiler mismatch, GPU quota <4h, malformed package or no matched result => stop and report without claiming score.
privacy: No reference patch, raw issue text, commands or trace are copied from private Kaggle to public GitHub; metrics only.
status: preregistered; no inference launched at time of manifest commit
